    let idPool = Array.from(new Set(initialIds)); // This Set holds all unique IDs
    let idsToProcess = Array.from(new Set(initialIds));  // This Set keeps track of IDs to process in the next loop
    let poolChanged = true;  // Flag to check if new IDs were added in each iteration

        poolChanged = false;

        let forwardSampleData = await forwardSampleDerivations.trigger({

                poolChanged = true;  // Set flag to true as the pool has changed
          }
        }
        idsToProcess = Array.from(newIdsToProcess);  // Update IDs to be processed in the next loop
    }

    return idPool;

function jsonToCSV(dataObj) {
  const headers = Object.keys(dataObj);
  const numRows = dataObj[headers[0]].length;
  const csvRows = [];

  // Add the headers row
  csvRows.push(headers.join(','));

  // Add data rows
  for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    const row = headers.map(header => {
      const value = dataObj[header][i] || ''; // Handle missing data with empty string
      const escaped = ('' + value).replace(/"/g, '\\"'); // Escape double quotes
      return `"${escaped}"`;
    });
    csvRows.push(row.join(','));
  }

  return csvRows.join('\n');
}
